channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Exhibition allows learning disabled people to tell their stories
item.description: Telling your own story is something learning disabled people haven't often been given much chance to do.

item.title: Government considers removing Andrew from line of succession
item.description: The government is considering introducing legislation to remove Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor from the line of royal succession.

item.title: Trump hikes global tariffs to 15% – what does this mean for the UK?
item.description: President Trump is digging in. A day after the Supreme Court's ruling prompted him to make his global tariffs 10% for everyone, he decided to raise them again with immediate effect.

item.title: ‘Enormous uncertainty’ over where tariff regime will end – economist
item.description: We spoke to the economist Neil Shearing from the independent research consultancy Capital Economics and asked for his reaction to the President's announcement on global tariffs.

item.title: Police search Andrew’s home as succession pressure mounts
item.description: Police are continuing to search the former home of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor on the Windsor Estate following his arrest and release on Thursday.

item.title: ‘It tears through my soul’: The story behind Oscar-nominated film The Perfect Neighbour
item.description: When 35-year-old black mother of four Ajike 'AJ' Owens was shot dead by her neighbour Susan Lorincz in Florida in 2023 there was outcry when the killer was not initially arrested and was allowed to return to her home - the scene of the crime.

item.title: Russia suspected over blasts appearing to target Ukrainian police
item.description: Russia is thought to have been responsible for two bomb explosions which appear to have been set off to target Ukrainian police officers.

item.title: Tories pledge to cut interest on some student loans in England
item.description: The Conservatives have promised to cut the amount of interest paid on some student loans in England amid widespread concerns over costs.

item.title: Britain’s ‘national photographer’ honoured in major new exhibitions
item.description: He was called Britain's ‘national photographer’, who was lauded for capturing the eccentricities of modern life and consumer culture through a lens of saturated color and sharp social observation.

item.title: ‘I can’t stay silent’: BAFTA-nominated film The Voice of Hind Rajab in focus
item.description: One of the most talked-about films nominated at tonight’s BAFTAs is The Voice of Hind Rajab, based on the final phone call of a five-year-old girl in Gaza.
